nodes.title: kon/place wrong-scale steer, note 004 answer 1 (branch claude/r8-steer-dir; NAMING_OFF unchanged). After a wrong-scale sighting the next level opens the same way as the sighting's level (cw after cw, acw after acw), with a key no sighting had (measure: on both scales; draw: the asked size), the same kind (acute or not) tried first. The sign each pattern carries: always the inner scale is wrong exactly on acw angles, always the outer on cw, always the larger number on acute, always the smaller on obtuse. Plumbing: FamilyLogic.steerOf (new, optional) -> chance memory `steer` -> levels.js steersOf -> body.steers -> GenRequest.steers; kon.place.ts placeSteer and placeNeeds `scale`. Draw (note 004 item 4, the dot differs): while the steer is on, a draw level's mix-up dot is never the right dot of the level just played (the steer alone put 'last time's right dot' at 0.125 by door, gate sweep). The level mix of answer 4 is asked from the third level (still by the fourth), so a one-side or one-kind reader's second sighting fits within the four (separate commit). Reverse if: a battery child who does not hold wrong-scale is named over 1 in 10 under the steer; or main rules the mix stays at the fourth level (revert that commit; inner and larger then fall to 0.17 and 0.19 in the gate sweep).
